login.title: Akeccum n Ucrik n Uẓeḍḍa
login.welcome: Ansuf yis-k! Asekcem iwakken ad tesselḥuḍ imsaɣen-ik.
login.heroTitle: Snerni taɣult-ik n tnezduɣt s yal aḍris ara d-tawiḍ
login.heroIntro: Yiwen n ubrid i usekles n imectariyen sɣur ibennayen, ad teṭṭfeḍ azal n yimḍebbren-ik yerna ad ten-teḍferḍ armi d asmi ara t-tebḍuḍ.

register.title: Ssekles imḍebbren deg tesdidin
register.text: Ssiweḍ-d amectari-inek d usenfar i ten-iɛeǧben.

protect.title: Aḥareb yettwasnulfan
protect.text: Lead-ik ad yeqqim d ayla-k i tallit n uḥareb, ihi ulac win nniḍen izemren ad d-yessuter amectari-nniḍen.

track.title: Ttbeɛ yal aḥric
track.text: Ẓer azal n yal aselway d umezruy-is akk, seg uskasi amezwaru ar usmel.

handover.title: Akredit deg usmel
handover.text: Mi ara d-yesbedd umectari, yettunefk lḥeqq i win yebnan s kečč yettwasekles d amcicki n uɣbalu.

login.secure: Akeccum aɣelnaw - isallen n imectariyen-ik ad qqimen d usligen

signup.title: Asekles n Ucrik n Uẓeḍḍa
signup.intro: Snulfu-d amiḍan-ik akken ad tebduḍ asekles d usnefli n yimḍebbren-ik.
